Name: Fall Creatures
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=5][color=#8e7cc3]Fall [/color][color=#e69138]Creatures[/color][color=#cc4125]![/color][/size]


[size=5]This mod changes the base head of the farmer. 

[color=#ff7700]About [/color][/size]
[size=3]They are here! [/size]
[size=3]Choose from 5* creature variants to replace the farmer head and become something else![/size]
[size=3]Match or mismatch them with hairstyles, accesories,  hats  and maybe custom costumes from another mods![/size]


[color=#ffe599][size=5]Suggestion [/size][/color]
[size=4]If you are making a new farmer. The hair type "[/size][size=5][color=#ffe599]Num. 53[/color]"[/size][size=4] is the one with no hair (Shown on the screenshots)[/size]



[color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Install[/size][/color]

[size=3]Install the requirements above[/size]
[size=3]Unpack inside the Stardewvalley/mods folder[/size]

[size=3]Open the config file and edit it to the creature of your choice.[/size]

[size=3][color=#ffd966]Note [/color]: While this mod requires the Muscular farmer mod, that mod can be fully deactivated in its config file.[/size]

[size=5]
[color=#93c47d]Config Options[/color] :[/size]

[size=3]inside the config file  you will find the field : [/size][/b][b][size=3]"Race": "wolf",[/size]
[size=3]Default to "wolf"[/size]

[size=3]Here are the possible inputs :[/size]

[color=#b6b6b6][size=5]wolf   [/size][/color]

[size=3]They are not limited to the night anymore!. Roam as a [color=#b4a7d6]furry [/color]beast in the valley day and night alike!.[/size]


[color=#ea9999][size=5]pig[/size][/color]

[size=3]This disgusting monsters have other ideas regarding to [color=#f1c232]livestock[/color]...  Townspeople better watch their backs![/size]


[color=#f4cccc][size=5]brain[/size][/color]

[size=3]Mindless humans who craves more [color=#ea9999]brains[/color]. They go super well in the classic rotten green and the futuristic bloodless blue.[/size]


[color=#ff7700][size=5]pumpking[/size][/color]

[size=3]They had enough of being [color=#e69138]harvested [/color]fall after fall.  Now they are the ones..... HaRvEsTiNg!!!....[/size]



[color=#6aa84f][size=5]squid[/size][/color]

[size=3]Do you ever [color=#b6d7a8]RylehFtang [/color]bro?.  Forbidden ones comes from the depth to recruit cultists to their dark cause.[/size]

[size=3](squid is limited to the male farmer*   When you choose this, a patch is made to delete the undershirt to discover more tentacles, Thing that cant be done to the female because SFW. )

[/size][color=#a4c2f4][size=5]none[/size][/color]
[size=4]
You are just a human.
[/size]
[/b]
